primary.description: Warm gold used for magnetic interactions, active states, and 3D rim lighting.

secondary.description: Muted teal used sparingly for hover states, tooltips, or subtle 3D material accents. NOT for primary CTAs.

body.description: Clean, geometric, highly legible for technical content.

mono.description: Used specifically for code snippets, tags, or small technical labels.

navigation.classes: fixed top-0 w-full z-50 backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#0D0D0D]/60 border-b border-white/[0.04]
navigation.interaction: Magnetic hover effect on links, smooth underline reveal using Framer Motion.

hero_section.visuals: React Three Fiber (R3F) Canvas as background. Floating low-poly geometric shapes (representing fragments of 2 worlds merging).
hero_section.interactions: Mouse parallax driving the camera/rotation of shapes. Name typing animation in foreground.
hero_section.typography_layer: Absolute positioned over canvas, pointer-events-none for text, explicit pointer-events-auto for CTAs.

about_section.portrait_column: lg:col-span-5. Image container rounded-none or subtle 4px. Grayscale portrait with amber hover tint.
about_section.globe_widget: Small R3F interactive wireframe globe embedded in the text column, plotting Malaysia -> France.

skills_section.layout: Full-width interactive field or grouped clusters.
skills_section.visuals: 3D Orbs (R3F) floating with custom shaders. Grouped by category (Frontend, Backend, Design).
skills_section.interactions: Hovering an orb halts its float, scales it slightly, and triggers an HTML tooltip overlay via Drei's <Html> component.

project_cards.interactions: 3D flip on hover using Framer Motion (perspective: 1000px, rotateY or rotateX).
project_cards.content: Front: Image + Title. Back: Tech stack, short description, links.

contact_section.background: tsparticles field simulating stardust or digital noise.
contact_section.form: Glassmorphism card, dense layout, floating over the particles.
contact_section.inputs: Shadcn based but customized: bg-transparent, border-b only, or 1px subtle outline. Focus state: border-[#C8903A].

motion_and_interactions.reveals: Scroll-triggered text reveals (lines or words animating up with opacity) using Framer Motion + Intersection Observer.
motion_and_interactions.cursor: Custom minimal dot that expands or magnetizes over interactive elements.

testing.requirements: All interactive elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case.

images.description: Abstract 3D floating geometry, subtle amber/teal rim lighting. Can be used as a fallback if R3F isn't fully utilized, or as a texture map.
Asian young male professional portrait for Ian's bio section. Dark background matches theme.
Minimalist digital dashboard interface for project card thumbnail.
Detailed tech interface for secondary project card.
